meta.name: Projector
meta.description: A projector variant. It adds projection focus, keystone correction, and projected-image size controls to the base display capabilities. Focus and keystone correction affect only the clarity and geometry of the projected image.

focus.description: Manual focus position on a normalized scale from 0 to 100. Higher values move focus toward the far end of its adjustment range, not necessarily toward greater clarity. Changes affect only projected-image clarity.

keystone.description: Signed vertical keystone correction angle in degrees. Zero applies no correction; positive values narrow the top of the projected image and negative values narrow the bottom. Changes affect only projected-image geometry.

image_size.description: Projected-image diagonal size in inches. Adjusting this setting changes only the projected-image dimensions without changing focus, keystone, or inherited display settings.

get_focus.description: Return the manual focus position under focus. Available only while powered on; otherwise fail without changing state.

focus.description: The manual focus position from 0 through 100.

set_focus.description: Set the manual focus position to an integer from 0 through 100 inclusive. This affects only projected-image clarity and does not automatically find optimal focus. Available only while powered on. Invalid arguments or a failed power precondition leave all state unchanged. Success returns no data fields.

get_keystone.description: Return the signed vertical keystone correction angle in degrees under keystone. Available only while powered on; otherwise fail without changing state.

keystone.description: Vertical keystone correction from -40 through 40 degrees.

set_keystone.description: Set vertical keystone correction to an integer from -40 through 40 degrees inclusive. Zero removes correction; positive values narrow the image top and negative values narrow the bottom. This affects only projected-image geometry. Available only while powered on. Invalid arguments or a failed power precondition leave all state unchanged. Success returns no data fields.

value.description: Desired signed vertical keystone correction in degrees.

get_image_size.description: Return the projected-image diagonal in inches under image_size. Available only while powered on; otherwise fail without changing state.

image_size.description: The projected-image diagonal from 30 through 300 inches.

set_image_size.description: Set the projected-image diagonal to an integer from 30 through 300 inches inclusive, changing only image dimensions. Available only while powered on. Invalid arguments or a failed power precondition leave all state unchanged. Success returns no data fields.
